title: Uganda Cocoa Projections
description: Uganda has not been a very big cocoa producer, but that is set to change. The country is now looking to increase its production and seeks to take advantage of the growing global demand. This comes as cocoa experts predict there will be a global cocoa deficit in the 2014/15 production year. From Kampala CCTV's Leon Ssenyange reports
author: CGTN Africa
